meta.author:
詞 楊家寧
曲 李宗唐

lines.a: 喔主 感謝祢創造這土地
lines.b: O Lord thank You for creating this land

lines.a: 以永恆話語 賜下無限生命
lines.b: You have given her everlasting life by Your living word

lines.a: 用恩典的馨香氣息 祝福這地
lines.b: You have blessed her with the fragrance of Your grace

lines.a: 讓我們全心 跟隨祢帶領
lines.b: So that she may be committed to follow Your lead

lines.a: 喔主 感謝祢創造這土地
lines.b: O Lord thank You for creating this land

lines.a: 以慈愛澆灌 以喜樂耕耘
lines.b: You have watered her with love, cultivated her with gladness

lines.a: 用無數的白晝黑夜 孕育這地
lines.b: And nurtured her with numerous day and night

lines.a: 順服的人情 感恩的心情
lines.b: Souls of obedience and hearts of gratitude

lines.a: 現在都只願 以基督的心為心
lines.b: Now are determined to be the same as Christ's mind

lines.a: 主求祢充滿我們 來醫治這地
lines.b: Lord we ask You to fill us and heal this land

lines.a: 痛苦疾病要過去 神蹟在運行
lines.b: Over pains and diseases, Your power is moving

lines.a: 主求祢充滿我們 來轉化這地
lines.b: Lord we ask You to fill us and transform this land

lines.a: 黑暗權勢要離去
lines.b: From us the power of darkness is leaving

lines.a: 主求祢充滿我們 來醫治這地
lines.b: Lord we ask You to fill us and heal this land

lines.a: 全地看見祢榮耀 祢復興降臨
lines.b: All people will see Your glory and Your revival come

lines.a: 主求祢充滿我們 來轉化這地
lines.b: Lord we ask You to fill us and transform this land

lines.a: 全地尊榮祢聖名 為祢而站立
lines.b: All people will raise and hallow Your holy name

lines.a: 一生祝福 永不停息
lines.b: Your endless blessings are with us all our days

lines.a: 世代因祢愛延續 呼求祢
lines.b: Your constant love will be called upon through ages

lines.a: 全地尊榮祢聖名 為祢而站立
lines.b: All people will raise and hallow Your holy name
